description: Break a cash amount down into the minimum count of bills/coins from a set of denominations, using the standard greedy largest-first approach (optimal for canonical currency denomination sets like USD, EUR, and GBP). Any amount that can't be represented exactly with the given denominations is reported as a remainder rather than rounded away.

amount.description: The cash amount to break down

denominations.description: Available bill/coin denominations, largest to smallest (defaults to US denominations: 100, 50, 20, 10, 5, 1, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05, 0.01)

name: calculate_cash_breakdown
